doc.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Helping all kinds of musicians
summary: The Foundation helps rappers, soul and rock musicians as well as jazz and blues.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: I guess, as you said, every case is different, so each one has to be approached with a different set of dynamics.

Is there a big learning curve for your staff. You’re dealing nationally, and musicians who are African-Americans from northern cities and from the south, Latino musicians, Caucasian musicians...really with a microcosm of America.
We’ve helped rap musicians. We’ve helped original rappers, and soul, and rock-and­ roll... I just don’t advertise it. But you go with your heart.
